title: Suspension Hamstring Curl
summary: A lying leg curl with your heels in suspension straps, combined with a hip bridge, for the hamstrings.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for hamstrings (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.
Library rating 0.4 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.25 for calves (minor): each working set adds 0.25 of a set to the weekly calves total.

setup.text: Lie on your back with your heels in the foot cradles and lift your hips.
Pull your heels toward your glutes, keeping your hips up.

form_cues.cue: Curl the heels toward your glutes
Keep your hips high the whole set.

mistakes.text: Dropping the hips during the curl.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
